_about: Real recorded CAN responses from OBDb test cases, header stripped, ISO-TP PCI kept. request_tx/response_rx are the addresses OBDb recorded. expected values are OBDb expected values in profile units (psi*6.894757 = kPa, kWh*1000 = Wh). Generated by testdata/gen_obdb_vectors.py from the OBDb repositories: Kia-Niro-EV 8cd9845, Kia-EV6 b6fb1f7, Hyundai-IONIQ-5 2477928, MG-MG4 a1bb5c0, Renault-ZOE 5c01658, Hyundai-Kona-Electric f898afb, Volkswagen-Golf 9a5635d, Volkswagen-e-Golf e4f58ec.
